acceptanceCriteria: For each of the six families: reproduce under N CPU burners with BASE vs fixed counts under the same load, or refute with counts.

Each reproduced family waits on an observed event or uses a test-only seam that leaves the product bound unchanged (a test pins the product value), and one mutation (seam not applied) brings the failure back.
Latency assertions that measure cancellation promptness keep their product meaning (assert ordering/termination rather than absolute wall time under load, or document the bound).
body: Residuals from the V1-1394/1393/1302 flake lane (PR #914, branch claude/flakes-1394-1393-1302, head 9800174d9, base 32c57367d, darwin go1.27.2, 12 cores, 64 `yes` burners, load 55-230). Observed failing under load, distinct from the three fixed tickets: (1) TestSourceViewCancellationTerminatesGitProcessGroup: 8 s / 10 s latency assertions, 3/3 failures under burners on BASE and fixed; (2) TestContextExpandRefusesWithoutSubstitutingContent: git-failed, the context_summary path has no deadline seam; (3) TestQualifiedLifecycle* (3 tests): qualified-lifecycle-unavailable; (4) TestAffectedUntestedGoPackageIsUnknownScope and TestAffectedUnownedDirtyPathIsUnknownScope: git-cancelled; (5) TestHostAdapterJavaScriptHosts AHI-034 cockpit RPC timeout; (6) localcompletion.Begin git-timeout in the ReadOnly test setup (local_completion_event_test.go:482) at load ~190. Pattern accepted in #912/#914: unexported context-key test seam (liftedProbeBound / liftedSourceDeadline) set only from _test.go, never widening a product bound. Umbrella: V1-0849.
title: cmd/corvint: six more test families fail under host load without a test-only seam (source-view cancellation latency, context expand, qualified lifecycle, affected unknown scope, JS host AHI-034, ReadOnly Begin setup)
